level.title: The new printer
level.story: A new floor, a new cable, and two teams want the shared drive at once.

level.title: Monday morning
level.story: Everyone logs in at nine. The cable to the file server was not made for that.

level.title: Exam week
level.story: Three halls upload at the same time. Find each of them a road.

level.title: Open plan
level.story: More desks than cables. Somebody has to take the long way round.

level.title: Ward round
level.story: Three wards ask the record system for the same files, all at once.

level.title: Gates open
level.story: Four entrances scan tickets into one server. Spread them over the field.

level.title: Morning rounds
level.story: Records and lab results want the same corridor. Keep both moving.

level.title: Lecture night
level.story: A live lecture, a downloaded course and a hundred students on the web.

level.title: Main gate
level.story: Ticket scans and a live stream share the same few cables.

level.title: Prime time
level.story: Everybody streams at eight. The metro ring is where it hurts.

level.title: Two tiers
level.story: The web tier and the video tier both talk to the same racks.

level.title: Town hall
level.story: The whole company watches the same talk while mail and files go on as usual.

level.title: Two roads
level.story: One big transfer and two cables that are each too small. Use both.

level.title: Main stage
level.story: The live stream is bigger than any single cable on the field.

level.title: Open day
level.story: Video, mail and the web portal share a cramped campus.

level.title: Cup final
level.story: The whole region watches the same match. Spread it over the ring.

level.title: Imaging day
level.story: Scans are huge, and every ward wants its own at once.

level.title: Big transfer
level.story: A migration needs every spare cable, and the shop must stay online.

level.title: The long call
level.story: Calls crackle when they take the busy road. Keep voice on a quick path.

level.title: Nurse call
level.story: The call system must be fast; the record system can wait a moment.

level.title: Crew radio
level.story: Crew calls must reach the stage manager while the stream is at its peak.

level.title: On-call
level.story: The ops bridge must stay clear while the build farm pushes out artifacts.

level.title: Helpdesk
level.story: Phones ring while a lecture streams and the portal gets its rush.

level.title: Emergency line
level.story: Emergency calls first, then the match, then everything else.

level.title: Backup night
level.story: The nightly backup wants every cable. Let it have what is left.

level.title: Scan archive
level.story: The imaging archive is huge and patient calls are not.

level.title: Batch window
level.story: Two bulk jobs, a web tier and a bridge call share the spine.

level.title: Mirror sync
level.story: The software mirror syncs at the worst hour. Slow it down, not the exams.

level.title: Upload rush
level.story: Everybody uploads photos while the crew needs the radio.

level.title: Software release
level.story: A release goes out to a million devices on the same night as the final.

level.title: Coffee break
level.story: At eleven the whole floor opens a video at once. Then it is quiet again.

level.title: Lecture ends
level.story: A hall of students reaches for their phones at the same second.

level.title: Encore
level.story: The crowd cheers, and every phone uploads the moment.

level.title: Shift change
level.story: Two hundred badges log in within a minute, then nothing for hours.

level.title: Goal!
level.story: A goal, and the whole region reloads the page in the same breath.

level.title: Flash sale
level.story: The sale opens at noon. The queues are there to be used, but not to be filled.

level.title: The cut cable
level.story: A builder digs through a cable. Give the important flow a way around.

level.title: Night shift
level.story: A link goes down at three in the morning. Monitors must not notice.

level.title: Storm
level.story: Wind takes down a metro link. Customers should hardly notice. The storm can cut either of two cables.

level.title: Pulled plug
level.story: Somebody pulls the wrong cable. The cluster has seconds to react.

level.title: Construction site
level.story: The digger is back, and this time it is the main trench. The digger may cut either of two cables.

level.title: Cable thief
level.story: Somebody cuts a cable for the copper, in the middle of the show.

level.title: The new wing
level.story: Two cables could connect the new wing. The budget pays for one.

level.title: Summer upgrade
level.story: A summer to rebuild the campus network, with money for part of the plan.

level.title: New ring
level.story: Close the ring in the north, or lay a shortcut across the lake. Not both.

level.title: Pop-up network
level.story: Three days, a field and a budget. Lay the cables that the crowd will need.

level.title: New building
level.story: The new wing opens in spring. Which cables does it need first?

level.title: Second hall
level.story: A second hall, a limited budget and a lot of traffic between the two. Either of two cables may be cut.

level.title: Wet cable
level.story: One link drops packets whenever it rains. Pay a little to be safe.

level.title: Payday
level.story: Payroll cannot lose a single packet. Everything else can lose a few.

level.title: Over the ridge
level.story: Radio links flicker. Commands must arrive, video may stutter.

level.title: Telemetry
level.story: Ventilator data and imaging cross a noisy wing. Protect the right one. Either of two cables may fail.

level.title: Fog
level.story: Wet air over the field, and the point-of-sale links lose packets. A few cables could still be built, within a budget.

level.title: Dirty fibre
level.story: A dirty connector drops one packet in five. The ledger cannot lose any.

level.title: Passing relay
level.story: A relay drifts out of range while another comes into range. Switch in time.

level.title: Search pattern
level.story: The swarm sweeps a valley. Links open and close as it moves.

level.title: Parade
level.story: The parade carries its own camera and radio, and the field links come and go.

level.title: Valley run
level.story: Four drones and one ground station, and every link has its time.

level.title: Ferry crossing
level.story: The ferry is in range of one shore, then of the other. A few cables could still be built, within a budget.

level.title: Rescue convoy
level.story: A convoy drives through the mountains. Radio links appear and vanish with every bend.

level.title: Guest wifi
level.story: Visitors may use the web, but never talk to the file server directly. Everything goes through the firewall.

level.title: Visitors and patients
level.story: Visitors, staff and the record system share one network. The firewall decides who passes.

level.title: The open lab
level.story: Students bring their own devices. Research data stays behind the firewall, and the firewall has only so much capacity. Either of two cables may fail.

level.title: Tenants
level.story: Two customers share a hall. Their traffic meets only at the firewall. A few cables could still be built, within a budget.

level.title: Press tent
level.story: Journalists upload from the press tent. The ticket servers are off limits.

level.title: Business park
level.story: Companies in the park share a link, and every one of them has its own firewall rules.

level.title: Spam wave
level.story: A flood of junk hits the mail server. Keep the rest of the office out of its way.

level.title: Packet storm
level.story: A storm of packets heads for the database. The backup has to wait.

level.title: Botnet
level.story: Thousands of hijacked cameras send traffic at one customer. The flood can come from either of two places.

level.title: Exam hack
level.story: Somebody floods the exam server minutes before the deadline. A few cables could still be built, within a budget.

level.title: Ransom note
level.story: The attackers want money, and send a flood to prove it. The flood can come from either of two places.

level.title: Ticket bots
level.story: Bots hammer the ticket server while real fans try to get in.

level.title: The big day
level.story: Enrolment, an open day and a storm in the same week. Either of two cables may be cut.

level.title: Black Friday
level.story: Payments, streams and a storm that cuts the coast road. A few cables could still be built, within a budget.

level.title: Rescue
level.story: Control, camera and a map for the rescue team, over links that come and go.

level.title: Heatwave
level.story: The cooling fails in one wing, a cable melts, and somebody picks the day to attack. A few cables could still be built, within a budget.

level.title: Launch day
level.story: A new product, a rush of customers and a flood from a competitor.

level.title: Headline act
level.story: The biggest stream of the year, a crowd that uploads and bots that attack. A few cables could still be built, within a budget.
